sentences.japanese: 彼は自分の時間をすべて歴史の研究に充てた。
sentences.english: He devoted all his time to the study of history.

sentences.japanese: 彼はその金を借金の返済に充てた。
sentences.english: He applied the money to the payment of debts.

sentences.japanese: 時間がないって？Tatoebaに費やしてる時間を充てればいくらでも出来るでしょ。
sentences.english: You don't have time? You would if you set aside the time you waste on Tatoeba.

sentences.japanese: リア充はみんなやってる。
sentences.english: All the cool kids are doing it.
